title: DIRECTIVE 07 — PLOTNIK PROTOCOL
body:
CLASSIFICATION: RESTRICTED / MILSPEC OVERSIGHT

In the event of an unclassified bio-event at Sub-Level 4,
surface operators are instructed to defer to on-site
security authority (SGT. D. MILLER) for all seal overrides.

Directive 07 supersedes standard research-safety chains of
command. No incident report is required for Protocol
invocation. No transcript will be retained.

— Directorate Liaison Office, Omsk
